item.title: Self-Hosted Web Application Firewalls: ModSecurity vs Coraza vs BunkerWeb (2026)
item.description: A Web Application Firewall (WAF) sits between your web applications and the internet, filtering malicious traffic before it reaches your servers. Self-hosted WAFs give you full control over security rules, logging, and blocking behavior without sending sensitive request data to cloud-based WaaS providers.
